blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Filipino folklore took the spotlight as Miss Grand Philippines Angelica Lopez transformed into “Ang Mangkukulam,” a national costume inspired by the mystery and mysticism surrounding one of the country’s most recognizable folklore figures. The costume draws from generations-old stories of the mangkukulam, a figure often associated with supernatural powers, while highlighting […]...
